<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a building material, that can either be [[mining|mined]] or purchased from [[Cory]], the stone vendor. Its primary purpose is the construction of certain [[Work Stations|workstations]] and mid-tier grave decor. Large stone blocks can be broken into pieces at the [[stone cutter]], after they're deposited at a [[Stone stockpile|stockpile]].
